This implies that **the green circle** is the **first shape**, and **its movement to the next shape (red triangle)** is the **shortest time** among all the transitions.

#### 4. **Conclusion**
While all movements take the **same amount of time**, the **green circle** is the **first shape** in the sequence, and thus the **only shape that has a "previous shape"** to which it **reaches**. This makes it the **only shape that could be considered** as taking the **shortest time** to reach from its **previous shape**.
